title: QUIZ - 13
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Convert a value from percentage form to fraction form
questions.question: Convert 12.5% (as a percentage) to a fraction.
questions.explanation: \( \frac{1}{8} \) = 0.125 = 12.5%. Since the question starts from the percentage form (12.5%), converting to a fraction gives \( \frac{1}{8} \).
questions.hint: Fractions, decimals, and percentages are different representations of the same value.

questions.hint: Fractions, decimals, and percentages are different representations of the same value.

questions.learningObjective: Convert a value from fraction form to decimal form
questions.question: Convert \( \frac{2}{5} \) (as a fraction) to a decimal.
questions.explanation: \( \frac{2}{5} \) = 0.4 = 40%. Since the question starts from the fraction form (\( \frac{2}{5} \)), converting to a decimal gives 0.4.
questions.hint: Fractions, decimals, and percentages are different representations of the same value.

questions.learningObjective: Identify which value is not equivalent to a given fraction
questions.question: Which of the following does NOT equal \( \frac{1}{8} \)?
questions.explanation: \( \frac{1}{8} \) is equivalent to 0.125 and to 12.5%, but not to 17.5%.
questions.hint: Convert every option to the same form (e.g., decimal) to check which one differs.
